categories.title: Product Marketing
categories.summary: Commercial product visuals that communicate benefit, surface material, context, and campaign message.
categories.guidance: Use case: product marketing. Ask for one clear hero product, concrete benefit, staged environment, readable short headline, premium lighting, material detail, and avoid watermarks, real brand marks, copied packaging, and illegible text.

zh.title: 产品营销
zh.summary: 突出商品卖点、材质、使用场景和活动信息的商业产品视觉。
zh.guidance: 使用场景: 产品营销。提示词要包含清晰主产品、具体卖点、陈列环境、可读短标题、高级布光、材质细节，并避免水印、真实品牌标、复制包装和不可读文字。

categories.title: Ecommerce Main Image
categories.summary: Clean marketplace-ready product images with simple composition and legible selling points.
categories.guidance: Use case: ecommerce listing. Keep the product dominant, background simple, edges crisp, props minimal, and text sparse; avoid marketplace UI chrome, fake badges, QR codes, and clutter.

zh.title: 电商主图
zh.summary: 适合商品列表的清爽主图，强调主体、卖点和干净构图。
zh.guidance: 使用场景: 电商主图。产品应占主导，背景简单，边缘清晰，道具克制，文字稀少；避免平台 UI、虚假角标、二维码和杂乱信息。

categories.title: Poster / Flyer
categories.summary: Event posters, campaign flyers, and graphic layouts where message hierarchy matters.
categories.guidance: Use case: event posters. Define headline, subhead, optional date-like microcopy, strong composition, readable text, and explicit hierarchy; avoid too many words and copied event identities.

zh.title: 海报 / 传单
zh.summary: 适合活动海报、传播传单和强调信息层级的图形版式。
zh.guidance: 使用场景: 活动海报。明确主标题、副标题、必要的日期式小字、强构图、可读文字和清晰层级；避免文字过多和复制现有活动身份。

categories.title: Social Media Post
categories.summary: Square or vertical posts designed for fast scanning, readable text, and memorable hooks.
categories.guidance: Use case: social media. Prioritize one hook, one visual focal point, high contrast, clean safe margins, and readable text at small sizes; avoid dense paragraphs and platform UI.

zh.title: 社交媒体帖子
zh.summary: 适合快速浏览的方图或竖图，强调钩子、可读文字和记忆点。
zh.guidance: 使用场景: 社交媒体。优先一个钩子、一个视觉焦点、高对比、干净安全边距和小尺寸可读文字；避免长段文字和平台 UI。

categories.title: Infographic / Educational Visual
categories.summary: Structured explanatory images with labeled sections, diagrams, and concise data storytelling.
categories.guidance: Use case: infographic. Ask for a clear title, 3-5 labeled sections, simple icons or diagrams, restrained palette, and readable labels; avoid fabricated exact statistics unless the user supplies them.

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
zh.summary: 带标签分区、图解结构和简洁叙事的解释性图片。
zh.guidance: 使用场景: 信息图。要求清晰标题、3-5 个标签分区、简单图标或图解、克制配色和可读标签；除非用户提供数据，否则避免编造精确统计。

categories.title: YouTube Thumbnail
categories.summary: High-impact thumbnails with oversized subject, bold headline, and strong contrast.
categories.guidance: Use case: thumbnail. Use one oversized subject, 2-5 word readable headline, emotional contrast, clear background separation, and no fake platform controls.

zh.title: YouTube 缩略图
zh.summary: 高冲击缩略图，强调大主体、粗标题和强对比。
zh.guidance: 使用场景: 视频缩略图。使用一个大主体、2-5 个词的可读标题、情绪对比、清晰背景分离，并避免伪造平台控件。

categories.title: App / Web Design
categories.summary: Product UI mockups, landing-page screens, and app showcase visuals generated as images.
categories.guidance: Use case: app or web mockup image. Specify viewport, product domain, layout density, components, sample data, and avoid implying real live connectors.

zh.title: App / 网页设计
zh.summary: 以图片形式生成产品 UI 样稿、落地页屏幕和应用展示视觉。
zh.guidance: 使用场景: App 或网页样稿。指定视口、产品领域、布局密度、组件、示例数据，并避免暗示真实实时连接。

categories.title: Text / Typography
categories.summary: Images where readable text, letterforms, hierarchy, and graphic type are central.
categories.guidance: Use case: typography. Keep wording short and exact, request readable text, define hierarchy and font mood, and avoid long paragraphs, misspellings, and cluttered layouts.

zh.title: 文本 / 排版
zh.summary: 以可读文字、字形、层级和图形字体为核心的图片。
zh.guidance: 使用场景: 文字排版。文案短而明确，要求可读文字，定义层级和字体气质，并避免长段落、错字和拥挤版面。

zh.title: 文字金句海报
zh.summary: 以一句准确短语和有表现力字形层级为核心的可读文字海报。
zh.prompt: 创建一张 {ASPECT_RATIO} GPT Image 2 文字金句海报，主题是 {USER_BRIEF}。使用一句准确短语作为主要可读文字，搭配有表现力的字形、强层级、平衡留白和支持可读性的图形背景。所有文字都要短且有意图。避免拼写错误、长段文字、水印、随机装饰字母和太小无法阅读的文字。

promptTemplates.title: Brand Wordmark Study
promptTemplates.summary: Type exploration image centered on a short invented wordmark and supporting layout notes.
promptTemplates.prompt: Create a {ASPECT_RATIO} GPT Image 2 brand wordmark study for {USER_BRIEF}. Center one short invented word or exact user-provided name as readable custom lettering, then add small supporting layout notes, spacing marks, and mood cues around it. Keep the presentation clean like a type specimen. Avoid real trademark imitation, unreadable glyphs, excessive decoration, watermarks, and long explanatory paragraphs.

zh.title: 品牌字标探索
zh.summary: 围绕短虚构字标和辅助版式说明的文字设计探索图。
zh.prompt: 创建一张 {ASPECT_RATIO} GPT Image 2 品牌字标探索图，主题是 {USER_BRIEF}。居中放置一个短虚构词或用户提供的准确名称，做成可读定制字形，并在周围加入小号版式说明、间距标记和情绪提示。整体像干净字体样张。避免模仿真实商标、不可读字形、过度装饰、水印和长解释段落。
